summary.en: Conan, Kogoro, Ran, Heiji, and Kazuha are going to a cottage located in Gunma Prefecture because of a crime that happened there. Kogoro feels sick, so he wanted to go in the toilet but when he came out, he feels weak because he ate a poisonous mushroom. According to Conan, when someone eats the mushroom, they feel its deliciousness but also feels it's poison. Kogoro goes into the forest and found some delicious mushrooms, when he ate it, he got poisoned. So he took a rest, supposed to be in the director's car, but Takashi was nowhere to be found. Heiji and Conan searched everyone's rooms. After that, Takashi has already died. They tried to called their cellphones but there's no service. They found a video leaning on Takashi's room, when he drinks the water, he was poisoned already. They discussed the case eight years ago.
